hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures pedestrians, especially children, from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: Walkway Obstruction
hazards.description: A silver SUV is parked directly on the paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk around it into the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Separation
hazards.description: There is no vertical curb or physical barrier separating the roadway from the pedestrian area, allowing vehicles to easily encroach on the walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Transition between asphalt and concrete area

hazards.name: Degraded Walkway
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved, continuous sidewalk, forcing pedestrians onto uneven dirt or into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the brick building

hazards.name: Lack of Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible for a long stretch, requiring pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic unprotected.

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can hide pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The wide roadway width without traffic calming measures may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located within the narrow sidewalk on the left side, reducing the effective walking width.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical buffer (like a planting strip) between the narrow sidewalk and the adjacent parking/travel lanes.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is heavily cracked and uneven, creating significant trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, across the entire width of the paved walkway.

hazards.name: Lack of Lighting
hazards.description: No streetlights are visible, which would result in very poor visibility and safety concerns after dark.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large parked vehicles and commercial signage block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to navigate the roadside.

hazards.name: Lack of Protected Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge areas are visible, requiring pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic unprotected.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Equipment
hazards.description: A large trailer with tanks is parked on the near side, blocking sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway and the side street intersection

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration of the main road creates a long, unprotected exposure time for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large box truck on the left side of the image creates a significant blind spot for pedestrians attempting to see oncoming traffic from that direction.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: There is no designated sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk in the travel lane or on unmaintained private property edges.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground along the building frontages

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A large SUV is parked parallel to the buildings, blocking the only available walking space and creating a visual barrier between pedestrians and moving traffic.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A large commercial truck is positioned in the roadway, creating a significant visual obstruction for both pedestrians and other drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked, high-visibility crosswalks to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use residential area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk pavement to eliminate tripping hazards and improve ADA accessibility.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the furniture zone or underground to provide a clear, unobstructed pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk remains clear of private structures like tents to maintain a continuous and accessible pedestrian path.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility, paired with high-visibility crosswalk markings.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and traffic while reducing the perceived width of the road to slow vehicles.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: Construct Paved Sidewalk
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant concrete sidewalk with a raised curb to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Relocate Utility Poles
interventions.description: Move utility poles out of the pedestrian clear zone to ensure an unobstructed walking path.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety along the industrial block.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees along the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Install Vertical Curbing
interventions.description: Provide a standard raised curb to clearly define the edge of the roadway and prevent vehicle encroachment onto the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the roadway and the walking path to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant concrete sidewalk on the left side of the street to ensure safe passage.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked midblock crossing with high-visibility paint to provide a designated and safer crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or other traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: Enhanced Street Lighting
interventions.description: Upgrade lighting to ensure the pedestrian walkway is well-illuminated, especially along the blank industrial frontage.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffers and Bollards
interventions.description: Install physical barriers or planting strips to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk and to provide a safety buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections and business entrances to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Physical Barriers
interventions.description: Install bollards or high curbs to prevent vehicles from parking on and obstructing the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant raised sidewalk with a curb to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: On-Street Parking Management
interventions.description: Clearly mark parking stalls to prevent vehicles from encroaching on pedestrian zones and maintain sightlines.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb on the left to provide a safety buffer.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the travel lanes and add clear markings to slow traffic and reduce the pedestrian crossing distance.
